sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Scavenger is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Listen brother, I've got a job for you. You know I'm pretty much the only guy who deals in all kinds of nylon. Well, I was. Lately, some competition has started popping up... I can't afford to lose my edge. And wouldn't you know it, one of my shipments is fucking delayed! Can you go around Tarkov and bring me some stuff to sell? I really need this, brother! Don't worry, I'll pay you for the goods. Here's the list of what I need."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Facecovers category
- Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Headgear category
- Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Headsets category
- Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Eyewear category category
- Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Body Armor category category

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"You collected everything? Ah, that's what I like to see!"
